QuestInfo.name: [Twilight Perion] Finding the Fog of Oblivion
QuestInfo.0: It'll take the Fog of Oblivion is required to sever the link between the dream and reality. But where can you find it?
QuestInfo.1: 'Everything's forgotten in time.' The Temple of Time might have the answers you're looking for. Go there and ask the #bTemple Keeper#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met the Temple Keeper at the Temple of Time.

0.0: (Where can I find the Fog of Oblivion? 'Everything's forgotten in time...')
0.1: (Time, as in the Temple of Time? I should ask the Temple Keeper. He might know something.)

yes.0: (I should return to the Temple of Time and meet the Temple Keeper.)

no.0: (I should give it some more thought.)

1.0: It's been a while. I heard you investigated the Gate to the Future. ...A dream world, hmm. Interesting...

yes.0: We mortals can never gauge our impact on the future -- nor the impact of seeing that future. To think that someone hatched a plot here in this sacred temple... But the #bGate of the Future remains sacred#k, and that is a comfort.
yes.1: By the way, why did you come see me? Huh? Do I know about the Fog of Oblivion?
